name: Natsuki Mana
source: The manager of the soccer club. Her father recently died, so there are now only three in her family: her mother, brother [url=/c10719]Natsuki Shin'ya[/url], and herself. She's a virgin and has no knowledge of sex, but is very interested in sexual things. She's Hozumi Yuina's rival for Murayama's affections.
